strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Explicit task.run on admitted provider retry tasks now revalidates source failure provenance before provider execution.
Retry execution does not bypass existing task-run network authorization, sensitive prompt guard, budgets, or provider selection.
The retry task only crosses into TaskRunning when current bounded source evidence still matches stored retry provenance.
Headless callers can safely execute an admitted retry task without stale failure handles or duplicate replay events.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances llm_provider_execution with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: task.run detects llm_provider_failure_retry_provenance and revalidates it against current source failure evidence before TaskRunning or provider calls.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M13.2 creates retry tasks from current evidence, but execution-time freshness was not checked before provider work.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Autonomous callers could hold and later run stale provider retry task handles after source evidence changes.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M13.1 classified failures, M13.2 admitted retry tasks, and M13.3 gates retry task execution.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. Existing task.run is extended; no report, status, digest, readiness, preview, history, or inspection RPC is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The behavior is an execution admission guard, not a new summary/readiness surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: task.run rejects stale or invalid provider retry provenance before TaskRunning and provider request events, while valid provenance proceeds through the existing provider path.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Controllers can move from admitted retry task to explicit execution with replay-safe stale-source rejection.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the minimal M13 chain: structured provider failure outcome, retry admission, and retry execution provenance revalidation.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M13.3 changes deterministic current phase manifest. Review must confirm task.run retry provenance revalidation behavior and stale-source denial rather than a wrapper or guard-only phase.

exit_criteria: Retry task admitted from a retryable provider failure can be run explicitly after provenance revalidation and enters the existing provider path
Stale source failure fingerprint is rejected before TaskRunning and before provider request events
Selected index context is rejected for LLM provider failure retry tasks
Terminal retry task replay does not duplicate TaskRunning or LlmRequestFailed events
Existing ordinary task.run and verification recovery retry behavior remain compatible
No raw prompt, provider response, request body, file content, stdout, stderr, commands, environment values, API keys, secrets, absolute paths, or canonical paths are persisted or returned
No new RPC, diagnostics wrapper, readiness report, digest, history, status wrapper, preview, automatic retry, scheduler, or VSIX-owned provider policy path is added
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M13.3 merge, favor M13 milestone closeout unless autonomous review identifies a remaining concrete provider execution gap.
